1.consolidated_definition: Terraza cubierta y rodeada de paredes de screen. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. Las mismas cuentan con 1 habitación, 1 baño, sala, comedor, cocina, acondicionador de aire central, screen porch y área de almacenaje (El Nuevo Día, 06-06-02)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Covered patio surrounded by screen walls. Raw anglicism, infrequently used. They typically feature 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom, living room, dining area, kitchen, central air conditioning, screened porch, and storage area (The New Day, 06-06-02)
